description: This file implements the GstProtectionMetadataWrapper class and related factory functions for managing protection metadata in GStreamer buffers within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: Interface for the factory that creates GstProtectionMetadataWrapper instances.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing creation of GstProtectionMetadataWrapper objects.

classes.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapper
classes.description: Class providing methods to add, retrieve, and remove protection metadata from GstBuffer objects.

methods.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new factory instance.

methods.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapperFactory::createProtectionMetadataWrapper
methods.description: Creates a new GstProtectionMetadataWrapper instance with the provided GstWrapper.

methods.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapper::addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapper::getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Retrieves protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: GstProtectionMetadataWrapper::removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Removes protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
